focus: What each of the five adapters still decides alone: guard shapes, runtime identity, entrypoint convention, event-name leniency
noveltyJustification: All four findings are new; the six-way arm-guard tabulation and the runtime-literal inventory had not been assembled in earlier iterations.
answeredQuestions: Which adapter-local behaviours still diverge across claude, codex, hermes, pi and the OpenCode plugin after the shared helpers landed?
ruledOut: Reporting nudgeDecision being called without env in the spawned hooks: the default process.env is the environment those hooks run in
Reporting the OpenCode plugin's silent catch around the arm path: the plugin has no log sink and hook logging is best-effort

label: One decision, 'is this record mine and still armable', has six implementations and three condition sets: Claude checks record and session only (claude/stop-arm.mjs:96,:100), Codex adds loopId but not runtime (codex/stop-arm.mjs:100,:107), Hermes, OpenCode and Pi check session and runtime but not loopId (hermes/session-end-arm.mjs:66,:74, opencode/session-relaunch.js:279,:285, pi/session-relaunch.ts:271,:275), and nudge.handoffPending asks a related variant (nudge.cjs:382). A record prepared for another runtime is refused by three arm paths and accepted by two. Fix: one core.armableRecord(record, { loopId, sessionId, runtime, env }) returning { armable, reason } over the full five-condition set, called by all five arm paths.

The runtime identity is a bare string in five files and an array in a sixth: prepare validates against LOOP_RUNTIMES (bin/session-relaunch.cjs:17) while each arm path compares a self-written literal ('hermes' at session-end-arm.mjs:70, 'opencode' at opencode/session-relaunch.js:280, 'pi' at pi/session-relaunch.ts:272) and each nudge passes the same literal (claude/context-nudge.mjs:109, codex/shared.mjs:113); RUNTIME_SEED_OPTIONS (relaunch-core.cjs:26) keys on three of the seven names. One rename has to be found in eight places and only the CLI knows the full set. Fix: export a frozen RUNTIMES from the core, build LOOP_RUNTIMES from Object.keys(RUNTIMES), and use RUNTIMES.<name> at every call site.

Three of five entrypoints run on import: codex/stop-arm.mjs:141 and hermes/session-end-arm.mjs:138 guard with isMain(), while claude/stop-arm.mjs:154, claude/context-nudge.mjs:120 and hermes/context-nudge.mjs:109 call main().catch(done) at module scope and the two Codex shims call runCodexAdapter at module scope (codex/context-nudge.mjs:15, codex/prompt-seed.mjs:15). Importing claude/stop-arm.mjs executes the hook and exits the process, which is why its arm path cannot be driven in-process by a conformance case. Fix: add the isMain() guard to all five entrypoints and export armPendingRecord(payload, dependencies) from claude/stop-arm.mjs shaped like hermes/session-end-arm.mjs:52.

A payload with no event name is accepted by Claude, which infers it from the payload shape (claude/context-nudge.mjs:42), and by Hermes, which treats an absent name as a match (hermes/session-end-arm.mjs:61), but dropped by the Codex shared adapter, which requires an exact match (codex/shared.mjs:69). Both policies are defensible but the rule is written in three places and stated in none. Fix: one hooksEvent(payload, expected, { inferFromPrompt = false }) predicate in shared/hook-adapter-shared.cjs that names the leniency as an argument, used by all three.
